scenes.title: Out of Egypt
beats: So God’s people left Egypt — men, women, children and all their animals — free at last!
God led them Himself: a tall pillar of cloud by day, and a pillar of fire by night, so they always knew the way.

layers.prompt: A huge crowd of Israelite families with donkeys, sheep and carts walks across the desert at dusk, right of center, following a towering pillar of glowing fire that rises high into the sky ahead of them

scenes.title: The Red Sea
beats: But then Pharaoh changed his mind and chased them with his army! God’s people were trapped at the edge of the sea.
“Don’t be afraid,” said Moses. “God will fight for you.” And he stretched out his staff over the sea —
— and God split the sea in two! Walls of water stood up on both sides, and God’s people walked right through on dry ground.

layers.prompt: At the edge of the Red Sea at night: Moses stands on a rock at the shore, right of center, raising his staff high over the dark waves, with a crowd of Israelites behind him and the chariots of Egypt far away in the dust

layers.edit: The sea now splits in two: tall walls of blue water rise up on both sides of a dry path straight through the middle, glowing in the moonlight, and the people begin walking through.

scenes.title: Safe on the Other Side
beats: Pharaoh’s army chased them right into the sea. But when God’s people were safe on the other side, Moses stretched out his hand again —
— and the water came rushing back! Pharaoh’s army could never chase them again.
God’s people saw what He had done for them, and they trusted Him.

layers.prompt: Sunrise on the far shore of the Red Sea: Moses and a crowd of Israelite families stand safe on the sandy beach, right of center, looking back at the calm, closed sea in wonder

scenes.title: Free!
beats: When they were safe on the other side, everyone sang to God.
Miriam grabbed her tambourine and danced, and all the women danced with her: “Sing to the Lord, for He has won a great victory!” God’s people were free!

layers.prompt: On the far shore of the sea in the bright morning sun: Miriam dances joyfully with her tambourine, right of center, as women dance with her and the happy people cheer
